visual_synopsis: A heavily made-up woman in a purple bob wig and red blazer - played in drag - sits blind drunk at the bar of an empty restaurant, smoking and slumping over her whiskey while the bow-tied bartender watches. A thin man in glasses and a knitted tie walks in, chats her up and walks her out with his arm around her; back at his apartment she passes out cold on the bed while he stands in the corridor making one phone call after another.
